==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Remember Lunya? Like her, but with teeth.|Kaliyo Djannis|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
Lunya is only mentioned by Djannis during the conversation with Anspi'shel if the Imperial Agent player is female.
